title_protection.quote: a person may not represent to the public, by use of a title, including "engineer", "professional engineer", "licensed engineer", or "registered engineer"

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this title, a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice engineering in the State unless licensed by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license for oneself or another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or licensee or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or a misdemeanor directly related to fitness and qualification to practice engineering.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: under the laws of the United States or of any state, the applicant or licensee is convicted of: 1. a felony; or 2. a misdemeanor that is directly related to the fitness and qualification of the applicant or licensee to practice engineering

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct while practicing engineering.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is guilty of gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct while practicing engineering

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice engineering in another state revoked or suspended for cause that would justify revocation or suspension in Maryland.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has had a license to practice engineering in another state revoked or suspended by the other state for a cause that would justify revocation or suspension under this title, except for the failure to pay a license fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any regulation adopted by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee violates any regulation adopted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the engineering title.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee violates any provision of this title

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Beginning on October 1, 2015, except as provided in subsection (b) of this section, a corporation, partnership, or limited liability company shall hold a permit issued by the Board before the corporation, partnership, or limited liability company may operate a business through which engineering is practiced.

definition_quote.value: to provide any service or creative work the performance of which requires education, training, and experience in the application of: (i) special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences; and (ii) the principles and methods of engineering analysis and design
definition_quote.quote: "Practice engineering" means to provide any service or creative work the performance of which requires education, training, and experience in the application of: (i) special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences; and (ii) the principles and methods of engineering analysis and design.

value: inspection of construction to ensure compliance with specifications and drawings
methods_authorized.quote: "practice engineering" includes: (i) consultation; (ii) design; (iii) evaluation; (iv) inspection of construction to ensure compliance with specifications and drawings; (v) investigation; (vi) planning; and (vii) design coordination.

covers_land_surveying.quote: There is a State Board for Professional Engineers in the Department.

covers_geology.quote: There is a State Board for Professional Engineers in the Department.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: If an individual passes the Fundamentals of Engineering examination and elects to obtain from the Board, on payment of a certification fee set by the Board, a certificate that states that the individual is an engineer–in–training, the Board shall: (1) keep a record that the individual passed the examination; and (2) issue to the individual a certificate

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: If an applicant has completed graduate study in engineering that is satisfactory to the Board, it may allow the applicant up to a 1–year credit toward the experience requirement

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge" means direct control and personal supervision of engineering that requires initiative, professional skill, and independent judgment.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Before a professional engineer issues to a client or submits to a public authority any plan, specification, or report, the professional engineer who prepared or approved the document shall endorse on the document the professional engineer's: (1) original signature and date of signature; and (2) seal or a facsimile of the seal.

seal_document_types.quote: Before a professional engineer issues to a client or submits to a public authority any plan, specification, or report, the professional engineer who prepared or approved the document shall endorse on the document

firm_practice_allowed.quote: a corporation, limited liability company, or partnership may provide engineering services through one or more professional engineers

value: federal government officers or employees performing official duties
regular employees of a public utility company providing engineering services to regulated facilities
officers or employees of corporations engaged in research and development engineering for the federal government
officers or employees of corporations engaged in manufacturing, industrial processes, industrial engineering, or maintenance and repair
employees or subordinates of a professional engineer working under responsible charge
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This section does not apply to: (1) an individual who practices engineering while performing official duties as an officer or employee of the federal government; (2) a regular employee of a public utility company while providing engineering services to any facility of the company that the State or federal government regulates to safeguard life, health, and property; (3) an officer or employee of a corporation, while the officer or employee practices engineering under the conditions authorized under § 14-302 of this subtitle; (4) an employee or other subordinate of a professional engineer, while the subordinate practices engineering under the conditions authorized under § 14-303(a)(1) of this subtitle

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: With the advice of the established engineering societies, the Board shall adopt, by regulation, a code of ethics for practicing engineering.

board_engineering_disciplines_represente.quote: Of the six engineer members of the Board: (i) one shall be a chemical engineer; (ii) two shall be civil engineers; (iii) one shall be an electrical engineer; (iv) one shall be a mechanical engineer; and (v) one shall be a professional engineer appointed without regard to specific professional practice who shall represent other designations of professional engineering.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Each engineer member of the Board shall have: (i) practiced engineering for at least 10 years; and (ii) been in responsible charge of important engineering work for at least 5 years.

retired_status_license_available.quote: The Board may issue a retired status license to an individual who: (1) is currently licensed in Maryland as a professional engineer; (2) has been licensed as a professional engineer for at least 25 years, of which at least 5 years were in Maryland
